rows.en:
(I forgot today's class is in another room.
Gotta hurry!)
rows.notes: idou kyoushitsu: a class held in a different room.

rows.en: Oof!

Owww...
S-Sorry, Luis-san...
Not a bad tackle...

But a mountain like me won't budge
from a little bump like that!
Come at me one more time!!
rows.notes: Echoes Luis's 'mountain called Luis Fernando' line (frd_lis_003).

rows.en: Um... Sorry, I'm in a hurry!
Aw, that's cold, Fresh Boy.

But you've got your own path
to walk too, don't you...

Go!
Go out there and blaze your own trail!!
O-Okay...?

(And come to think of it, Luis-san...
why is he just hanging around
the school hallway like it's normal?)

(I forgot today's class is in another room.
Gotta hurry!)

Ugh...
S-Sorry, Luis-san...
Aw, that's cold, Fresh Girl.

(And come to think of it, Luis-san...
why is he just hanging around
the school hallway like it's normal?)
(What should I have for lunch today...)

What's with the worried face,
Fresh Boy?
rows.notes: Luis uses the loanword 'worry' (uoorii na kao).

rows.en:
Oh, Luis-san.
I was just trying to decide what to have for lunch.

Talk about perfect timing!
I was just about to go grab a chili dog.
What do you say, wanna come eat with me?
Sure, then I'll tag along.

By the way, Luis-san, are you into
junk food like chili dogs?

Yeah, I like 'em...
No, not 'like'... it's LOVE!
That's what this feeling of mine is!!
L-Love...?

Whoops, is 'love' still a bit too early
for a boy like you?
Whatever, let's get a move on.
(What should I have for lunch today...)

What's with the worried face,
Fresh Girl?

Whoops, is 'love' still a bit too early
for a girl like you?
Whatever, let's get a move on.

(Phew, that EX-Gear training class
wore me out...)

Yo, Fresh Boy.
Wearing an EX-Gear, huh? Lookin' slick!

All right, let me wear that slick EX-Gear too.
C'mon, lend it here and let me try it on.

Huh? Um, no... With your build, Luis-san,
you'd never fit into my EX-Gear.

Don't be so stingy.
I'll make up for that part with passion.

(I don't think that's something
passion can fix...)
All riiight, let's try this baby on!

Ah, Luis-san,
don't handle it so roughly...
(I hope my EX-Gear doesn't break...)

(Phew, that EX-Gear training class
wore me out...)

Yo, Fresh Girl.
Wearing an EX-Gear, huh? Lookin' slick!

Huh? Um, no... With your build, Luis-san,
you'd never fit into my EX-Gear.
(I hope my EX-Gear doesn't break...)

(Come to think of it, how does Luis-san
spend his days off?)

Luis-san, how do you
spend your days off?
Same way I spend any other day.

After all, every day's pretty much a day off for me!
Ha ha ha ha ha!
(That's no laughing matter... Luis-san......)

(Fifty laps around the field in PE class
is way too much...
Hilda-sensei......)

If a little thing like this tires you out,
you've still got a long way to go, Fresh Boy!

L-Luis-san!?
What on earth are you doing?

Isn't it obvious? I'm running laps
around the field with you guys, of course!

(Is it really okay for him to just
barge into a class like this?)

Sure, the finish line might be close,
but this ain't enough to set my passion ablaze!
Now I get serious-aaaaah!
W-Wait, Luis-saaaaan!!

(Looks like he ran right off out of the school...
I've got another class next,
so I guess I'll head back to the classroom......)

If a little thing like this tires you out,
you've still got a long way to go, Fresh Girl!

(Looks like he ran right off out of the school...
I've got another class next,
so I guess I'll head back to the classroom......)

(Nyan-Nyan's Galaxy Ramen
really was superb...)
(Wait, is that Luis-san?)

Luis-san, what are you doing
in front of Nyan-Nyan?
Oh, just... a little something...

Nyan-Nyan's always looked after me, so I've been
trying to think of some way to repay 'em, but...
Repay them?

Seeing you just gave me an idea!
With this, I might be able to pay 'em back.
How are you going to repay them?
I put on one of Nyan-Nyan's China dresses, see...

Um, wait a minute...
You mean you'd put on a women's China dress, right?
Well, obviously, Fresh Boy?
I-I really think you'd better not...

(That's not repaying them,
that's just sabotaging their business, Luis-san...)

(Nyan-Nyan's Galaxy Ramen
really was superb...)
Well, obviously, Fresh Girl?

uncertain: c17533: 'Seeing you just gave me an idea' - the scene never says what about the player sparked Luis's China-dress idea; kept literal.
c17480/c17484: inner monologue opens by naming Luis-san then continues in the third person, as the Japanese does.
